notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms.us list supports this entry; its row has no unit, so 925 is read as feet (the brief's 281.9 m matches). The list has no register code for Zebulon. Two WebSearch rounds found no lookout at Zebulon. A search result pointed to a Zebulon communications structure, which is not a lookout and is not used. Story is short (about 100 words) because one list row is the only evidence. Brief status and access 'unknown' are kept.
